escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, early morning): the Efeonce meeting room named «Cerrar.», from the chair at its table, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at the smooth light grey matte plaster back wall 2.5 m away; horizon level, verticals straight. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of that part of the wall — the room name «Cerrar» with its magenta sphere as the period and, under it, a tall portrait whiteboard with a hand-drawn bow-tie diagram (two triangles meeting at a magenta dot) and the handwritten sentence under it. Reproduce Image 2 exactly as real materials: the room name as cut matte navy vinyl letters with a magenta vinyl dot; a real glossy enamel whiteboard with a slim aluminium frame and marker tray; the drawing and sentence in real dry-erase marker. LEFT THIRD: high on the wall, a minimalist matte black steel hand bell on a slim black steel bracket — the bell the sales team rings when a deal closes; lower, beside a slim black-framed glass door at the left edge, a wall-mounted room booking panel whose screen shows Image 3 exactly (the room name, the filled magenta status sphere and «En sesión»). At the bottom LEFT corner of the pale table, the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid DEEP NAVY (#023C70, dark ink blue, never royal blue) desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright on the table between 4% and 24% of the frame width, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), satin finish, crisp bevel, its long shadow falling to the right. LIGHT: low early-morning sun from the LEFT through slim black venetian blinds paints crisp parallel stripes of light and shadow across the wall, the bell and the whiteboard; dust glows inside the stripes; the centre of the wall stays calm. TRACES OF WORK: a dry-erase marker with its cap off on the whiteboard tray; a graphite mesh chair pushed back at an angle below the board; a half-finished coffee in a plain white cup on the table. MODERN FLOOR (2026, premium technology company): floor-to-ceiling glazing with slim black frames; smooth exposed concrete ceiling with recessed black linear LED profiles switched off; seamless pale microcement floor; furniture with clean lines — pale solid-surface or light-oak tables on slim black steel legs, graphite ergonomic mesh chairs, handle-less storage; current-generation technology only. At most ONE sculptural plant in the whole frame. Nothing vintage or rustic: no reclaimed wood, no brass, no Edison bulbs, no wooden brackets, no clutter. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artworks from Image 2 and Image 3 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
